The meeting emphasized the continuation of a moderately loose monetary policy, the comprehensive use of various monetary policy tools, and the maintenance of ample liquidity. It aims to effectively implement the 'Five Major Financial Tasks,' accelerate the construction of a multi-level modern financial market system, enhance the adaptability of financial services to the real economy, and better support economic transformation, upgrading, and the transition of growth momentum. It also focuses on effectively preventing and resolving financial risks in key areas. The meeting called for expanding high-level financial openness, promoting the internationalization of the renminbi, and accelerating the construction and development of a multi-channel, widely covered cross-border payment system for the renminbi. Announcement of New Funds Bonus Rules | HTXHome> Announcement> Announcement of New Funds Bonus RulesAnnouncement of New Funds Bonus Rules02/05 16:00:00 (UTC)|Latest News|Official|Affiliates SpecialTo incentivize partners and clients to drive real and sustainable capital growth, the HTX platform has officially launched the “New Funds Bonus Trial Program”, under which we will provide ongoing bonus incentives based on the amount of real net new funds deposited on the platform.
Since the new funds bonus mechanism represents an innovative cooperation model within the industry, this event will be introduced in a trial operation format.
During the trial period, the HTX platform will conduct standardized calculation, settlement and distribution in accordance with the rules outlined in this announcement.
Upon conclusion of the trial period, the HTX platform will review market conditions and actual operational results, and may optimize or iterate the rules accordingly, with prior notice. bonuses.requirements: Kalshi and Polymarket Collaborate with Major U.S. Media for Election Prediction Trading Volume of Approximately $1.5 BillionHomeFeedNewsKalshi and Polymarket Collaborate with Major U.S. Media for Election Prediction Trading Volume of Approximately $1.5 BillionKalshi and Polymarket Collaborate with Major U.S. Media for Election Prediction Trading Volume of Approximately $1.5 Billion10/30 10:41According to Bloomberg, as the U.S. midterm elections on November 3 approach, the commercial collaborations between prediction market platforms Kalshi and Polymarket and media groups such as CNN, CBS News, CNBC, Dow Jones, and Fox have garnered attention. Bloomberg estimates, based on Dune data, that the total trading volume for midterm election-related prediction markets on the two platforms is approximately $1.5 billion. The report states that CNBC's partnership with Kalshi involves customer acquisition and minority equity investment, CBS News lists Kalshi as a sponsor for its prediction market, and the Wall Street Journal, under Dow Jones, showcases data from Polymarket. CNN has indicated that it will not reference prediction odds during live coverage on election night, while Fox News has explicitly excluded political reporting from its collaboration with Kalshi.
